dom: @xmldom/xmldom 0.8.11 with a bounded Range endpoint model

checks.name: Pinned package CFI names the actual spine item
Second spine item has its own package address
Pinned fromRange preserves a UTF-16 range over the supplementary character
Package path resolves to the expected itemref
Pinned CFI endpoints resolve to the same original text node
Resolved source quote is preserved exactly
Range collapses into two complete native anchor values
Native boundary validation rejects a half-surrogate endpoint
Native boundary validation rejects an oversized offset
Source serializer escapes commas inside ID assertions
Escaped assertion still resolves the same text node
Adjacent text and CDATA share a logical CFI text chunk
Repeated quote does not require first-match searching
Source fixed-page address is explicitly synthetic
Synthetic fixed-page index remains zero based
Fixed EPUB has a real package layout declaration
Fixed EPUB page base resolves to its actual second spine item
Source archive bytes were not changed

limits: No real browser Range or rendered selection test.
No source application or Kana jump.
These unchanged synthetic source trees do not prove arbitrary injected or translated DOM compatibility.
The source parser is not a production untrusted-input validator.
